listings.name: Wire Worx manufacturers
listings.current_description: Wire Worx Manufacturers has made wire and mesh display products since 1997, starting with wire toy cars and growing into a full range of wire and mesh displays supplied to stationery, arts and craft, and hardware retailers.

listings.name: Wires and Wifi
listings.current_description: Wires And Wifi is an IT services company, founded in 2016, offering wired and WiFi network setups, CCTV installation, computer sales and repair, printer sales and repair, and web development and hosting for homes and small businesses.

listings.name: wkinc
listings.current_description: wkinc (WK Attorneys) is a law firm in Doornpoort, Pretoria, covering ante-nuptial contracts and matrimonial law, labour law and CCMA representation, wills and estate administration, divorce, contract drafting, corporate services, debt collection and rent interdicts, and conveyancing.

listings.name: WOW Marketing Agency
listings.current_description: WOW Marketing Agency is a remote-first creative agency based in Pretoria with additional offices in the Garden Route and London, offering branding, website design and development, graphic design, photography and videography, digital marketing and editorial design services.

listings.name: Wrap Your Brand
listings.current_description: Wrap Your Brand is a Kilner Park creative studio offering vehicle branding and wraps, indoor and outdoor signage and banners, promotional products and branded merchandise, corporate identity design, and digital marketing services including websites and social media.

listings.name: Xakwa Holdings
listings.current_description: Xakwa Holdings is an African mining company managing mining operations and a mineral portfolio across multiple commodities, running exploration projects and supporting community development through the Xakwa Foundation, from its Park Lane West office in Waterkloof Glen.

listings.name: Xaro
listings.current_description: Xaro is a CETA-accredited mining training provider delivering programmes in Dangerous Goods handling, Working at Heights, forklift and crane operation, lifting equipment, First Aid, environmental awareness, hazmat handling and rigging, serving the mining industry nationwide from Erasmuskloof.

listings.name: XPest Pest Control Services (Pty)Ltd Head Office
listings.current_description: XPest Pest Control Services has operated across Gauteng since 1986, specialising in the eradication of ant, cockroach, rat and termite infestations from residential, commercial and industrial premises, and offering STERIFOG microbial disinfection fogging and wood-destroying-insect clearance certificates.

listings.name: Yellohost.co.za
listings.current_description: Yellohost.co.za is a web hosting provider based in Erasmia offering shared hosting plans with a free website builder, SSD storage, free SSL certificates, free email and cPanel, aimed at individuals, small businesses and corporate clients.

listings.name: A AND H ELECTRONICS SOLUTIONS PTY LTD
listings.current_description: A and H Electronics Solutions is a security systems installer in Eersterust providing alarm systems, electric fencing, access control, intercoms, gate and garage motors, CCTV surveillance and palisade steel fencing, along with a guarding division and ongoing maintenance.

listings.name: ABC Hansen Africa
listings.current_description: ABC Hansen Africa is an agricultural equipment supplier based in Samcor Park, specialising in grain storage and handling systems, milling solutions, and oil-seed and oil-expelling equipment, manufacturing and distributing processing equipment for the grain value chain since 1995.

listings.name: AdminOnline, product of Jalia Technologies
listings.current_description: AdminOnline, a product of Jalia Technologies, is a cloud-based management system that helps small businesses and service providers such as sports coaches, arts instructors and tutors handle invoicing, communication and administration, used by over 26,000 registered families.

listings.name: Allair centurion
listings.current_description: Allair is an air-conditioning and refrigeration company established in 1994, based in Lyttelton Manor, Centurion, supplying and installing air conditioners, heat pumps, cold rooms and freezer rooms for residential, commercial and industrial clients across Gauteng and neighbouring provinces.

listings.name: ALP Africa (Pty) Ltd
listings.current_description: ALP Africa, trading from Rosslyn since 2008 (formerly Glengyn (Pty) Ltd, having acquired Tensile Rubber Extrusions in 2014), manufactures and exports industrial rubber and plastic extrusions and moulded components, including EPDM profiles, silicone gel pads and PVC products.

listings.name: Amandla Pumps
listings.current_description: Amandla Pumps is a South African manufacturer of industrial submersible, waste-water and slurry pumps, established in 2002 and based in Koedoespoort Industrial, Pretoria, producing its Jenny J-Series and Varkie S-Series pump ranges for the industrial and mining sectors.

listings.name: Amax Electronics
listings.current_description: Amax Electronics is a security technology company in Sinoville, Pretoria with over 22 years of experience, installing and maintaining electronic security systems for gated communities including video surveillance, access control, electric fencing, boom gates and turnstiles across Gauteng.

listings.name: Arcadia Hotel Pretoria
listings.current_description: Arcadia Hotel Pretoria is a 3-star business hotel at the foot of the Union Buildings in Arcadia, forming part of the Arcadia Shopping Centre, offering a fitness centre, private parking, a restaurant, 24-hour front desk and free WiFi.

listings.name: Aroma Coffee Roastery
listings.current_description: Aroma Coffee Roastery is a single-origin coffee roastery established in 2010 in The Village shopping complex, Hazelwood, Pretoria, roasting and packing coffee within 24 hours and offering coffee, gelato, brownies, cheesecake and waffles for dine-in, takeout or delivery.

listings.name: Artiflex Engineering (Pty) Ltd Head Office
listings.current_description: Artiflex Engineering is an automation engineering company established in February 2004, headquartered in Lyttelton Manor, Centurion with offices in Gqeberha, Cape Town and Bloemfontein, providing PLC and SCADA systems, MCC manufacturing, telemetry, energy monitoring and solar system integration.

listings.name: As-Built Laser Scanning
listings.current_description: As-Built Laser Scanning is a 3D laser scanning and modelling company in Shere, Pretoria East, converting point-cloud scans into detailed 3D CAD models and 2D as-built drawings for facilities managers, architects, engineers and construction professionals across South Africa.

listings.name: Auto Pedigree 473 Stanza Bopape St, Arcadia, Pretoria, 0083, South Africa
listings.current_description: Auto Pedigree Pretoria Central is a used-car dealership in Arcadia, part of a South African brand with over 35 years in the industry, stocking around 3,000 used vehicles that each undergo a 116-point mechanical and electrical inspection.

listings.name: Automould Pty Ltd
listings.current_description: Automould is a technical plastics injection moulding manufacturer for the motor industry, established in 1984 and now part of the METAIR group via Smiths Plastics, operating an IATF 16949-certified Pretoria plant producing injection-moulded and painted components and sub-assemblies.

listings.name: Bazaruto Seafoods Centurion
listings.current_description: Bazaruto Seafoods Centurion is a fresh seafood shop next to Centurion Mall on South Street, stocking hake, salmon, kingklip, tuna, prawns, crab, mussels, oysters, scallops and calamari, with fresh fish delivered three times a week and never frozen.

listings.name: Beefcor
listings.current_description: Beefcor is a fully integrated beef company based in Rosslyn, founded in 1973 with 1,000 head of cattle and now marketing up to 70,000 cattle a year, supplying meat through butcheries and merchants across South Africa.

listings.name: Bene Ba EL Holdings (Pty) Ltd
listings.current_description: Bene Ba EL Holdings (Pty) Ltd, founded in August 2015 and based in Heatherdale, Pretoria North, is a real estate agency handling property buying, selling and renting alongside marketing, management, consulting, general construction and social media marketing services.

listings.name: Bentich (Pty) Ltd
listings.current_description: Bentich (Pty) Ltd is an accounting, taxation and consulting firm in Erasmuskloof founded in October 2020 by husband-and-wife team Benjamin and Leticia du Toit, serving individuals, companies, partnerships, charities and non-profits with a combined 19 years of experience.

listings.name: Bespoke Legal
listings.current_description: Bespoke Legal is a Pretoria law firm directed by Rudi, a University of Pretoria LLB graduate (2009) who later earned an LLM from UNISA (2014), specialising in creative and design law for start-up businesses and cost-effective dispute management.

listings.name: Bidvest Prestige Pretoria
listings.current_description: Bidvest Prestige's Pretoria office, based in Samrand Business Park, is a contract cleaning and hygiene service provider covering contract cleaning, specialised cleaning, training, event staffing, healthcare workers and mobile toilet hire, serving commercial, retail, healthcare and industrial clients.

listings.name: Big Brand Productions Signage
listings.current_description: Big Brand Productions is a Pretoria signage and large-format printing company on Selati Street in Ashlea Gardens, established in 2009 and producing banners, vehicle signage, illuminated signs and eco-friendly options as part of the Marketing Support Services Group.

listings.name: Big foot outdoor gear
listings.current_description: Big Foot Outdoor Gear is a small Koedoespoort business making custom canvas products and repairs for the outdoor industry, along with stainless steel braai equipment; its shower tray, vanity organiser and visor organiser are among its best-selling items.

listings.name: Bladkon (Pty) Ltd
listings.current_description: Bladkon (Pty) Ltd, established in 1982, specialises in concrete construction of suspended floor and roof slabs for residential projects, providing in-house structural engineering design and reinforcement cutting and bending, alongside partner companies Eastern Readymix and ERM Pumping Services.

listings.name: Body Guru Montana
listings.current_description: Despite the "Body Guru" name and gym category, the linked website (mybodyguru.co.za) operates as an online store selling protein powders, workout supplements, vitamins and healthy snacks under brands such as Fully Dosed and My Protein Pantry.

listings.name: BosBoma - Country Venue
listings.current_description: BosBoma is a countryside event venue in Kameeldrift East, Pretoria, hosting weddings, birthdays, anniversaries, corporate functions, and other private celebrations with exclusive single-event-per-day use, bush and chapel ceremony settings, and homemade cuisine, accommodating roughly 10 to 120 guests.

listings.name: Boshoff & Smith Attorneys
listings.current_description: Boshoff & Smith Attorneys is a boutique law firm operating from Southdowns Ridge Office Park in Irene, Centurion, with an additional office in Johannesburg, specialising in family law, deceased estates, commercial law, civil litigation, and wills and trusts.

listings.name: Branch-Out Tree Farms
listings.current_description: Branch-Out Tree Farms is an indigenous tree nursery east of Pretoria near the N4 toward eMalahleni, stocking roughly 24,000 trees in container sizes from 10 to 100 litres, serving both individual buyers and landscaping and nursery professionals.

listings.name: Bressan Civils
listings.current_description: Bressan Civils is a Black Woman Owned, BBBEE Level 1 civil engineering company based in Heatherdale, Pretoria, offering project management, civil construction (site construction, tower erection, access roads), maintenance of telecoms and network sites, and SHEQ consulting services.

listings.name: British Xabhaya - Prepaid Electricity & Water Meter
listings.current_description: British Xabhaya is a Pretoria-based utility management company providing prepaid electricity and water meter supply, installation, and online token vending, along with energy and water audits, leak detection, and meter-to-cash solutions for residential, commercial, and sectional title properties.

listings.name: Bruni Physiotherapy
listings.current_description: Bruni Physiotherapy in Rietondale, Pretoria offers physiotherapy services to diagnose, treat and rehabilitate injuries, with a focus on sports including rowing, running, athletics, triathlon, swimming, soccer, tennis, rugby and cricket. The practice also runs Yoga and Pilates classes.

listings.name: Business Plan Now
listings.current_description: Business Plan Now sells ready-made, industry-specific business plan templates and custom business plans for South African entrepreneurs, starting from R200 and including 5-year financial forecasts; the company says it has assisted more than 3,900 entrepreneurs since 2019.

listings.name: Business Synergy
listings.current_description: Business Synergy is a Centurion-based training technology company that builds Learning Management System (LMS) and Learner Content Management System (LCMS) software, along with a BI/reporting server, aimed at reducing administrative costs and improving compliance for training organisations.

listings.name: Buzuci
listings.current_description: Buzuci, based in Lyttelton Manor, Centurion, is a printing, gifts, clothing and branding business offering laser engraving, heat transfer, pad printing, sublimation and textile printing for corporate gifts and custom apparel, as well as foam and upholstery products.

listings.name: BuzZ Group
listings.current_description: Buzz Group is a Hatfield-based technology company operating across three areas: IT and AI services (hardware, software, backups and cybersecurity), solar power systems (panels, inverters and battery storage), and home/business automation (lighting, security, climate and access control).

listings.name: BVi Consulting Engineers Pretoria
listings.current_description: BVi Consulting Engineers Pretoria is the head office of the BVi Group, a multi-disciplinary engineering firm established in 1967 offering civil, structural, electrical and mechanical engineering consulting, and a Level 1 B-BBEE contributor with more than 300 professionals.

listings.name: CAPITAL CITY BUSINESS CHAMBER (CCBC)
listings.current_description: The Capital City Business Chamber (CCBC) is a business chamber based in Rosslyn, Pretoria, that supports business growth in the Tshwane region through networking events, a member business directory, and facilitating collaboration between government, business and the community.

listings.name: Capital House
listings.current_description: Capital House Boutique Hotel, also known as The Waterkloof Mansion, is a five-star boutique hotel at 369 Victoria Street in Waterkloof, Pretoria, offering 12 rooms, an outdoor swimming pool, garden and free Wi-Fi, with breakfast included in stays.

listings.name: Car Service City
listings.current_description: Car Service City is a vehicle repair and maintenance chain; this branch in Hennopspark, Centurion offers services including air conditioning, brakes, clutch and gearbox repairs, engine diagnostics, electrical work, exhaust systems, suspension and steering, tyres, and windscreen replacement.

listings.name: Carany Catering & Hiring
listings.current_description: Carany Catering & Hiring, established in 2000, is a Villieria, Pretoria-based caterer offering wedding, corporate, fine-dining and kiddies-party catering with a range of food platters, alongside event equipment hire such as tableware, linens, marquee tents and popcorn machines.

listings.name: CB Steelworks
listings.current_description: CB Steelworks is a steelwork design and fabrication business located on Sapphire Street in Klerksoord, Pretoria, listed in South African business directories under that category. Its website itself provides no further detail beyond a bare server directory listing.

listings.name: Champion Boarding Kennels & Cattery
listings.current_description: Champion Boarding Kennels & Cattery offers short- and long-term boarding for dogs and cats at its premises opposite Roodeplaat Dam, welcoming pets of all ages and sizes but not aggressive dogs or unsterilised dogs over six months old.

listings.name: Cheryl Muller Business and Executive Coach
listings.current_description: Cheryl Muller is a certified ActionCOACH business and executive coach based in Irene, Centurion, helping entrepreneurs and companies of various sizes with sales and marketing strategy, leadership development, profit optimisation and operational efficiency, including quarterly GrowthCLUB planning workshops.
